comparison.objective: Switch a named wall switch off and secure it with a lockout cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Select and actuate a switch, then position and engage a lockout device; no impact fracture or tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Body states switch OFF and locked out, with a full-score demo; detailed engagement, force, and final-state tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests state selection plus safety-cover locking, not insert finishing, hammer regulation, or containment of four detached tangs.
